name: Nieragan
backstory: Child of Niemoran and Nieragus; grew up around walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn... in Salthos Cruzados, and knows something of Gorff.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dorukus.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnakus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dornakus.
Heard that Nieragus and Dorakus now have a child, Nieradus.
Heard that Darnakus and Niemoran now have a child, Niemornak.
Had a child with Niekus, named Nierakus.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Toll Ledger Arrears
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Toll Ledger Arrears
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes the dawn shift at the crossing alone now, checks papers quickly, and saves the real listening for the travelers who look like they're hiding something

arc.premise: Nieragan has stopped just collecting traders' grumbling as loose evidence, and started building a proper complaint box at his post - every grievance written down and filed the moment it's spoken, so the arrears case has something on paper instead of hearsay.
